description: This Java class implements the default value function (`fn:default`) used in a pipeline processing context. It defines the function's signature, parameter definition, and application logic for resolving default values when placeholders are unresolved.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionDefault
classes.description: Provides the implementation of the `fn:default('...')` function used in pipeline expressions.

classes.name: DefaultFunctionSignature
classes.description: Defines the signature for the default function, including its parameter definitions.

classes.name: DefaultValueParam
classes.description: Specifies the 'defaultValue' parameter for the default function, including its type and description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, which is 'default'.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of the default function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the default function to a given PipelineElement, resolving to a default value if the original is unresolved.

methods.name: parseAndResolveThrow
methods.description: Parses and resolves the parameter string, throwing an exception on errors.
